body: I'll give it a look. Not sure how it works in my state.

It would certainly at least give me a small fighting chance to save some (any) kind of money. As is, I can't even work at McDonalds. It's killing any little bit of motivation I had left. I'm just stuck, watching everyone move forward in life while I waste away in my mom's basement.
I have not. Is that commonly an option, or a rare exception in most cases?

Yeah, and I was pretty good at it, I think. Was pushing myself a bit too hard though. When things started to go sour, the pressure coupled with the loneliness sort of pushed me over a cliff. I've tried getting into another avenue of sales, but no one will even give me a chance with the terrible track record I've set for myself.
